payload.name: Preserve all explicitly listed elements in extracted memories
payload.description: When a message explicitly lists two or more distinct topics, activities, preferences, or facts (e.g., joined by 'and' or commas), extract each element separately instead of merging or dropping any.
content: During extraction: if the source statement explicitly enumerates multiple items, topics, activities, preferences, or facts (e.g., 'dreams and life'), include every listed element in the candidate memory content. Do not replace the full list with a single umbrella phrase or omit any item.
When updating existing memories, preserve all previously recorded listed elements unless the new message explicitly changes or removes one.

solves: Diagnosed cause: candidate extraction paraphrased an explicitly enumerated pair ('dreams and life') into a single theme, dropping one element. The reusable failure mechanism is lossy summarization of explicit lists during memory extraction. This applies to future conversations where a speaker enumerates multiple topics, activities, preferences, or facts in one clause; the extracted memory should retain every listed element so later questions can be answered completely.
